title: Objectwise transported etale inverse image module
statement: Let U,V be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:U → V, and O a commutative-ring sheaf on V's small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Use the set inverse image L and the fixed abelian inverse image La, and their adjunctions [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures]. Let Lr be any ring inverse image left adjoint to the sectionwise ring direct image, with natural comparison er to L; let ea compare La with L. Suppose both adjunction hom equivalences commute with forgetting through er and ea. For each O-module sheaf G [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], there exists an Lr(O)-module sheaf HG and an abelian-sheaf isomorphism eG: FU(HG) ≅ La(FV(G)). Put iG = FaU(eG) followed by ea at FV(G). There exist source and target scalar-action sheaf morphisms muV and muU with the actual sectionwise scalar multiplication values, and L(muV) = prodComparison(L) followed by (er(O)^(-1) times iG^(-1)), muU, and iG. This asserts only objectwise existence, not any maps between objects or functoriality.

proof.text: Use etaleInverseImageAlgebraicStructures for finite-limit preservation and etaleInverseImageModuleActionLaws for the module structures on the sections of the fixed abelian inverse image.

Construct the scalar-action sheaf morphism from sectionwise multiplication using map_smul. For the transported action, evaluate naturality at the unique product section with projections r and x. Substitute the section action formula to obtain semilinearity of restriction. Assemble the module presheaf with PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf and inherit the sheaf condition from the fixed abelian inverse image. Its underlying abelian comparison is the identity. Identify its action with the conjugated action on sections and cancel the ring, abelian and product isomorphisms to obtain the required comparison equation.
